title: Zelensky Accuses US of Inaction as Russian Strikes Kill Nearly 80 in Two Days
detail: President Zelensky publicly accused the United States of inaction as Russian strikes killed nearly 80 people across Ukraine over two days. The strikes continued a pattern of intensified Russian bombardment targeting civilian infrastructure and population centers.

title: Russia-Ukraine Competition Extends to West Africa's Sahel
detail: Analysis finds Russia-Ukraine geopolitical rivalry has opened a new front in West Africa's Sahel region. Russian military influence and Wagner-successor forces continue to expand across the region, while Ukraine actively courts Sahel governments in a bid to counter Moscow's growing footprint and build diplomatic support.
